podcast.title: Medieval Inspiration in 19th Century Romanticism
podcast.body: The obsession with the medieval is not new; since the Romanticism of the 19th century, artists and musicians already looked to the Middle Ages as a source of mystery, epic, and lost spirituality. This era saw the emergence of operas evoking knights and crusades, and a neo-Gothic architecture that restored the grandeur of castles and cathedrals to the collective imagination. "Desde el romanticismo del siglo XIX, artistas y músicos ya miraban hacia la admedia como una fonte de misterio, épica y espiritualidad perdida."

srcs.episode: Por qué todo suena medieval en 2025? (Dungeon Synth, Bardcore...)
